title: Climate Sentinel Kenya - Action Playbook
note: Planning-support only. Actions are taken from the cited guidance documents; the agent may only recommend actions listed here. Official warnings from the Kenya Meteorological Department and the National Disaster Operations Centre take priority.

drought.Emergency: 3-month rain below 25% of normal (comparable to NDMA 'Emergency')

flood.Watch: 3-day rain (observed or forecast) at or above the county's 95th percentile
flood.Warning: 3-day rain at or above the county's 99th percentile
flood.Emergency: 3-day rain at or above the county's 99.9th percentile, or flooding reported

cyclone.Watch: Cyclone season (Nov-Apr) in a county with recorded storm exposure, or a storm reported in the South-West Indian Ocean by RSMC La Reunion/KMD
cyclone.Warning: Only when KMD or RSMC La Reunion has issued an official warning for the Kenyan coast (this tool never forecasts storm paths)
cyclone.Emergency: Storm impacts occurring or imminent per official warnings
